description: Parliament  of Sri Lanka - Notify of Convening of the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Tuesday, 06 th February, 2018 at 10.30 a.m.
categorisation: This gazette content is a notification by the Speaker of Parliament convening a parliamentary session on a specific date. This falls under electoral and parliamentary processes, specifically the scheduling and convening of parliamentary sessions, which is classified under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with the functioning and scheduling of the legislative body.
